book_tomas: Previous notes suggested bed_b1 for evening/late night based on Day 21. On Day 22, it was at coffee_table_l1 at 09:37 and 10:20 (morning). The location is highly variable and not fixed to bed_b1. Check coffee_table_l1 for morning (08:00-12:00) and evening queries. Do not assume bed_b1 unless specific recent evidence points there.

charger_tomas: Previous notes suggested nightstand_b1 for late night based on Day 21. On Day 22, it was at coffee_table_l1 at 10:54 (morning). The location is highly variable. Check coffee_table_l1 for morning (08:00-12:00) and mid-day. For late night (22:00+), check nightstand_b1 first, then armchair_l1, but be aware coffee_table_l1 is a frequent location.

mug_tomas: Previous notes suggested coffee_table_l1 for morning and late night. On day 20, it was at kitchen_table_k1 at 08:11 (morning) and coffee_table_l1 at 11:39 (late morning). The "morning" pattern is inconsistent; it moves between kitchen_table_k1 and coffee_table_l1 in the 08:00-12:00 window. Check both spots for morning queries. Keep checking coffee_table_l1 for late night (22:00+).

water_bottle_tomas: Previous notes suggested desk_o1 for mid-day. On day 20, it was at coffee_table_l1 at 14:18 (mid-day). The "mid-day" pattern of desk_o1 is unreliable. Check coffee_table_l1 for mid-day (12:00-18:00). Keep checking coffee_table_l1 for morning (08:00-12:00), dining_table_d1 for early evening (18:00-21:00), and sink_k1 for late night (22:00+).

glass_tomas: Previous notes suggested cupboard_k1 for late night. On day 21, it was at nightstand_b1 at 22:16 (late night). The "late night" pattern of cupboard_k1 is incorrect. Check nightstand_b1 for late night (22:00+) queries.
